# API client (official SDK)

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

The provider's official SDK behind an app contract: the contract, an SDK-backed client that turns SDK errors into one exception carrying no request data, a Fake bound in tests, config/services.php and .env.example keys, and a test against the Fake. The app never calls the SDK or Http:: directly.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make api-client --flavor=sdk <Name>`.

Kit: none.
Checks: integrations. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Is there an official SDK, and a fake driver for tests?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=integrations.api-client` to see its siblings.
